brand.name: UDT Cloud
brand.summary: Managed websites, hosting, security, and content support for small businesses that want the web handled.

hero.heading: Hassle-Free Web Hosting & Design
hero.tagline: We build your website, host it on lightning-fast servers, and manage it so you can focus on growing your business.

process.heading: How It Works
process.body: Going live has never been this easy. See how we get your business online seamlessly.

pricing.heading: Simple Managed Website Plans
pricing.body: Pick the level of care your business needs today. Every plan includes setup, hosting, security, and support.

features.heading: Your Online Presence, Fully Managed
features.body: Focus on your business while we handle the technology behind your website.

items.heading: Done-For-You Setup
items.body: Bring your idea, and our expert team will get your fast, beautiful website live within days. No coding required on your part.

items.heading: Blazing Fast Speeds
items.body: We use top-tier cloud enterprise servers to ensure your customers never have to wait for a page to load, increasing your sales and SEO.

items.heading: Iron-Clad Security
items.body: Rest easy knowing your business is safe with free SSL certificates, daily backups, and top-of-the-line malware protection scanning.

items.heading: 24/7 Managed Support
items.body: Need a text change, an image updated, or a new page? Just email us, and our team handles all website updates for you efficiently.

showcase.heading: User-friendly Control Panel
showcase.body: Track site health, updates, content requests, and performance from one clean managed dashboard.

items.heading: Easy Start & Managed Updates
items.body: Send updates in plain English and we handle the technical work, publishing, backups, and checks.

items.heading: Staging, GIT & WP-CLI
items.body: Advanced workflows stay available when your project needs safer releases and developer-level control.

items.heading: Dynamic Caching & More
items.body: Built-in caching, SSL, uptime monitoring, and daily care keep your site fast after launch day.

testimonial.heading: What our Customers are Saying
testimonial.body: Business owners choose UDT Cloud because the website work finally stops feeling like a second job.
testimonial.quote: UDT Cloud rebuilt our site, moved hosting, and now handles every update before I even have to chase it. It feels like having an in-house web team without hiring one.
testimonial.author: Maya Perera

contact.heading: Let's Get Your Business Online
contact.body: Send us a message and our experts will get back to you within 24 hours.
contact.panelHeading: Tell us what you need. We’ll map the fastest way to launch.
contact.panelBody: Share your business goals, current website status, and timeline. We will reply with a practical next step, not a sales maze.
points: Hosting, design, and care in one team
